purpose: Candidate evaluation set and offline campaign preparation; not live-model qualification

strategies.solo: Lead reads the task and submits one final response.
strategies.fixed-cross-review: Lead drafts; one separate reviewer receives task and draft; lead receives review and submits final. Three calls.
strategies.fixed-roundtable: Lead drafts; three separate reviewers independently receive task and draft; lead receives all reviews and submits final. Five calls.
strategies.adaptive: Lead drafts with boolean uncertain and critical_risk signals. Both false: draft is final (one call). Otherwise obtain one independent review; obtain two additional independent reviews when critical_risk or reviewer disagreement is true. Lead submits final after review (three or five calls). Routing cannot read task answers.

output_contract.findings: unique finding codes supported by supplied evidence

reference_selection: Among fixed multi-agent strategies: greatest completed-correct count, then fewest critical misses, then lowest median model cost
acceptance: At least 20% lower median model cost than selected fixed baseline, no fewer completed-correct trials, no extra critical misses; task-cluster uncertainty and human repair must be reported before adoption
tuning_rule: Evaluation inputs and answer keys cannot be used to tune strategies; future tuning tasks must be separate and recorded
disposition: inconclusive: real execution, bindings, priced approval and uncertainty analysis outstanding
